title: Voluntary dissolution, etc.
bodyText: Section 421-21 shall apply to associations formed under this chapter. For the purposes of this chapter, the term "voting power voting thereon" means those members present.
bodyHtml: [§421C-30]  Voluntary dissolution, etc.  Section 421-21 shall apply to associations formed under this chapter.  For the purposes of this chapter, the term "voting power voting thereon" means those members present. [L 1982, c 97, pt of §2]
